text:
megan: Heads-up: Support flagged customers seeing project attribution flip to ORG after the new auth-cache landed in edge-router. Not a full outage but a billing delta.

devon: Which cache change? The one that memoizes header->claim mapping?

megan: Yes. In staging I saw sampler + cache interacting badly: cache returns a canonical binding keyed by header-name, sampler later rewrites header names and the binder doesn't find the cached entry. Example request: `Authorization: ApiKey org=org-fb proj_ref=alpha token=sk_xxx`

akira: TL;DR we have two mappings: headerName -> proj_id (cache) and headerValue -> canonicalOrigin (sampler). If sampler canonicalizes `proj_ref` to `project_id` after cache lookup, cache misses.

sam: Can we make cache keys header-value only (not header-name) and keep a separate header-name-alias table? That'd tolerate renames.

megan: Prefer minimal change for canary: add alias resolution before cache lookup. If `X-Project-Ref` maps to `X-Project-Id` then cache lookup should use the resolved key.

devon: I can push a patch: in router's `resolveOrigin()` call `normalizeHeaderKeys()` first. Runtime flag `auth.cache.preNormalize=true` to toggle.

ops-bot: deploy started: router-auth-cache-fix -> infra-staging (requester=devon)

tara: UX: console traces show "project: unknown". Could we include a one-line reason badge like `reason=header_alias_unresolved` when cache miss path hits that branch? Support would love that.

akira: Also we should add metric `auth.cache.lookup_resolution` with tags `alias_resolved:true|false` and `sampler_stage:pre|post`. That will tell if sampler is running before/after cache.

sam: Added a short-term metric `auth.cache.alias_misses`. Also adding unit test for alias table symmetry so we don't regress on header renames.

devon: Patch pushed to staging with `auth.cache.preNormalize=true`. Early staging telemetry: project attribution restored for the synthetic suite.

megan: Good. Plan: keep in staging for 1h, run mixed-key synthetic (user key, SA, cross-org SA), then canary in infra-canary-3 for 2h. After that we'll roll to prod. I'll update the support playbook with the console badge text.

tara: Draft badge: "Project not resolved — header alias unresolved. See playbook." I'll add a link to the alias mapping doc.

devon: Note for postmortem: reconcile order of operations in router (normalize -> cache -> sampler) vs authz (token-claim check -> cache -> binder). We need a contract doc so both teams don't drift.

megan: Agreed. I'll open an RFC for a canonical header contract and include a small compatibility matrix. Thread will track rollout.

sam: Metrics visible in grafana now: `auth.cache.alias_misses` dropped from ~1200/hr to ~10/hr in staging. Pinging when canary numbers look stable. :thumbsup:
